sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti Tarnish Gold Double Layer Snake Chain Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a bold yet elegant statement with this double-layer twisted snake chain bracelet in a rich gold finish. Two intertwined flat snake chains flow beautifully together, secured with a lobster clasp and a signature Morchadi "M" coin tag. Anti-tarnish & versatile enough to wear solo or stacked.
